title: Add lighter Infinigen import path and retry one_bed_apartment
objective: Implement a lighter Unreal import path for the one_bed_apartment Infinigen scene after repeated import OOM kills, then run the lighter retry in tmux so the user can monitor it.
instructions: Do not perform Git operations or commits.

Inspect examples/flashlight/setup_infinigen_indoors.py and the retry2 logs under /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/one_bed_apartment_import_retry2_20260626T164341Z/logs to confirm the failure mode.

Add narrowly scoped CLI flags to examples/flashlight/setup_infinigen_indoors.py for lighter import options. Keep existing default behavior unchanged. At minimum support disabling static mesh auto collision generation, e.g. --no-auto-generate-collision. If local Unreal import APIs support it safely, also add optional flags to skip importing materials/textures or other expensive static mesh import data, but keep defaults backward-compatible.

Use the new lighter flag(s) to retry importing the existing r256 FBX: /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/one_bed_apartment_import_retry2_20260626T164341Z/export_r256/export_scene.blend/export_scene.fbx.

Run the retry in a fresh detached tmux session named spear_one_bed_apartment_import_light. The retry should use --replace-existing-assets and --replace-existing-map for /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/one_bed_apartment/Meshes and /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/one_bed_apartment/Maps/one_bed_apartment.

If the lighter import succeeds, run the cook/package/archive step for /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/one_bed_apartment/Maps/one_bed_apartment. If it fails, leave tmux open and report the exact failing command, exit code, and relevant memory log lines.
Verify the tmux session exists and capture-pane shows the lighter import or cook actually started before returning.
constraints: No commits, no pushes, no PRs.
Keep product code changes minimal and backward-compatible.
expected_outputs: Updated import script with lighter CLI option(s).
Detached tmux session spear_one_bed_apartment_import_light running or completed the lighter import/cook workflow.
ResultPacket with changed files, tmux attach command, run root/log location, status, and next run command if successful.
definition_of_done: Code supports a lighter import flag without changing default behavior.
Lighter one_bed_apartment import/cook retry is dispatched in tmux and status is clear.
